description: This file defines custom distributed operators related to device mesh coordinate computations in PyTorch, including registration of fake and real implementations for the operator 'device_mesh::_runtime_compute_coordinate_on_dim'. It manages operator declaration, symbolic shape constraints, and concrete execution logic tied to the distributed device mesh functionality.

classes.name: DeviceMesh
classes.description: A class representing the distributed device mesh, with methods to retrieve mesh information and compute coordinates.

methods.name: SymInt _runtime_compute_coordinate_on_dim_fake( full_mesh: torch.Tensor, index: int )
methods.description: Fake implementation for the custom operator, generating a symbolic dimension coordinate with size constraints based on the full_mesh tensor.

methods.name: int _runtime_compute_coordinate_on_dim_impl(full_mesh: torch.Tensor, index: int)
methods.description: Concrete implementation that computes the coordinate on a given dimension in the device mesh based on the current distributed rank.
